versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Tencent Cloud MPS (Media Processing Service) skill.
- Supports generating Python script commands for video/audio/image processing, AI generation, and content understanding scenarios.
- Strictly enforces command output and mandatory confirmation rules for processing tasks to prevent accidental charges.
- Integrates cost reminders, environment variable checking, and detailed mapping of user intent to supported scripts.
- Requires references documentation consultation before generating any command.
- Clearly distinguishes between processing, query, and upload/download task types.

tencent-mps 1.3.1 更新日志

- 新增详细脚本职责映射与处理场景明细，覆盖转码、增强、擦除、字幕、图片/音视频处理、AIGC及质检等全流程。
- 明确强制命令生成规范，细化交互确认、费用提示、环境变量配置及异步任务结果查询规则。
- 丰富常见用例及误用约束，规范所有命令引用脚本 references 文档，禁止绕过主流程。
- 优化环境说明，脚本参数及 COS 相关用法补充最新配置指引。
